newsitem.title: BRAZIL: RESEARCH ALERT - Santista Alimentos cut to hold.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Santista Alimentos cut to hold.

text.p: -- Fator Securities said it has downgraded Brazilian food company Santista Alimentos to hold from buy.
-- The brokerage said the stock has appreciated by 50 percent since August 9, when it rated the stock a buy.

-- Explaining the downgrade, it said, "Fourth quarter sales, which were below expectations, will be reflected in the stock's short-term performance and lead us to reduce our net income forecast for 1996 to 42.1 million reais from 45.9 million reais."
